A '''Dhani woman''' lived on [[Aldhani]] while [[Gorn]] was stationed on the [[planet]]. Gorn fell in love with this woman, who he eventually "lost". Following that, he lost faith in the regime and became a [[spy]] and an inside man for [[Vel Sartha]], and was part of her [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|team]] that partook in a [[Aldhani heist|mission]] on [[Aldhani]].<ref name="The Axe Forgets" />
